stops.name: Bregenzerwald
stops.quote: Among Austria's most heavily forested regions are the Waldviertel in Lower Austria, the Bregenzerwald in Vorarlberg, the Lungau in SalzburgerLand, the Nockberge Biosphere Reserve in Carinthia and the Silberregion Karwendel in Tirol.
stops.english: Among Austria's most heavily forested regions are the Bregenzerwald in Vorarlberg, the Waldviertel in Lower Austria, the Lungau in SalzburgerLand, the Nockberge Biosphere Reserve in Carinthia and the Silberregion Karwendel in Tirol.
